scoring_justification: Checker recomputes the analytical formulas (Eqs. 33,34,25,42,43) from the agent's output points and compares with relative tolerances.

outputs.description: Self-energy components at Omega values [0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.5, 1.0]. The checker recomputes the reference values from the analytical formulas.
Phase shift η(εF) in radians. The checker recomputes the reference value from the analytical formulas.
Indirect interaction energy for inter-adatom distances d = 2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9,10,12,15,20 a0. The checker recomputes the reference values via numerical integration of the analytical expressions.

output_contract.notes: All outputs are compared to reference values recomputed by the checker using the same analytical formulas and parameters (β=0.8, l=0.244 a0, Vaa=-0.019 Ry, εa=0.102 Ry, kF=0.55 a0^-1, εF=0.3 Ry). Tolerances accommodate minor numerical integration differences but require correct implementation.

steps.description: Compare agent Lambda and Delta at each of the 6 Omega values to recomputed values.
Compare agent phase shift at εF=0.3 Ry to recomputed value.
Compare agent W_ab at each distance to recomputed value via numerical integration of Eq. (42).
